_comment: Configuration for Angel SmartAPI websocket -> Kafka tick forwarder. Update credentials, Kafka brokers, and symbol lists for your environment.
angel_comment: Angel API credentials and tokens. feed_token can mirror refresh_token if dedicated feed token is not issued.
kafka_comment: Kafka connection settings for publishing normalized ticks to topic ticks.raw.
symbols_comment: Symbols to subscribe: indices and equities. Format: EXCHANGE:SYMBOL-SUFFIX.
log_comment: Logging configuration: level and output file path.
reconnect_comment: Reconnect behavior: backoff between retries and watchdog/rotation thresholds.
